references.title: Source Editor references
references.description: Format citations and add or edit citation sources
lookup.sourceHelpText: Type to filter the list. Generate from a URL, archive link, identifier (DOI, ISBN, ISSN, PMID, PMCID, or QID), or citation text; leave empty to fill in a source manually. An existing source is reused directly.
lookup.useSourceHint: Use source (Ctrl/Command-click to add sub-reference details)
lookup.editSubReferenceUses: Changes apply to all {count} uses of these details.
lookup.referenceDetailsDescription: Add page numbers, quotations, or other details for this use. Leave empty to reuse the main reference.
lookup.sourceRequired: Enter a source URL, identifier, or citation.
lookup.ambiguousSource: This URL is cited in more than one reference group. Choose the citation to reuse from the source list.
lookup.duplicateWarning: Saving creates a new source. The original source will not change.
lookup.replaceWarning: Saving replaces the original reference with this citation template.
lookup.metadataUnavailable: Source details could not be loaded: {error}

tools.scriptTitleAllForeign: Use script-title for every foreign language

feedback.linkCheckFailed: The article link could not be checked. Check it manually.
feedback.cancelUnavailable: Changes made by Source Editor cannot be canceled because the article changed elsewhere.

feedback.sourceAppliedReordered: Citation source applied; parameters were reordered.
feedback.newSourceCs1IssueOne: CS1 found 1 issue. Correct it before saving.
feedback.newSourceCs1IssueMany: CS1 found {count} issues. Correct them before saving.
analysis.title: Citation name consistency
analysis.intro: Review possible differences in website, publisher, author, reference-name, and source-key text. Choose the text to keep and the citations to update. Parameter names will not change.
analysis.revertUnavailable: This change cannot be reverted because its source changed.
analysis.undoUnavailable: These changes can no longer be undone because the article changed afterward.
analysis.closeConfirmationBody: This session includes applied citation consistency changes. Choose whether to undo or keep them, or continue editing.
analysis.selectOne: Select at least one citation to change.
analysis.sameDisplayStyle: Only link, case, spacing, or wikitext style differs.
analysis.sameHostValue: Citations for the same website use different names.
analysis.authorReason: The same author name uses different wikitext, link, case, or spacing style.
analysis.someMissingSourceKey: Some repeated uses have a source key and others do not.
analysis.differentSourceKey: Repeated uses have different source-key comments.
analysis.someMissingAlias: Some repeated uses have reference-name text and others do not.
analysis.differentAlias: Repeated uses have different reference-name text.
analysis.sourceMissing: A selected citation source is no longer present. Run the check again.
analysis.replacementConflict: One citation field has more than one replacement. Review the selections and apply them again.
analysis.sourceChanged: A citation source changed after the check opened. Run the check again.
analysis.fieldChanged: A selected citation field changed after the check opened. Run the check again.
checker.cs1Description: Checks citations against the CS1 rules currently used on {wiki} Wikipedia.
checker.unavailable: The CS1 check is temporarily unavailable. Run it again later.
checker.nonCs1Description: Finds references that do not use a supported CS1 citation template.
validation.invalidParameterName: Enter a parameter name without wikitext markup or line breaks.
validation.unsupportedParameter: CS1 does not support the {parameter} parameter.
validation.aliasRequiresValue: Enter the original text before setting reference-name text.
validation.archiveUrlRequiresDate: Add a date for the archive URL.
validation.archiveDateRequiresUrl: Add an archive URL for the archive date.
errors.sourceChanged: The source changed after it was opened. Open it again to continue.
tool.editorScope: Changes update the editor. Publish them with the wiki’s save action.
draft.parametersDescription: Edit the citation fields below. Highlighted fields contribute to its reference name.
tools.scriptTitleAlways: Use script-title for every language, including this wiki’s language
tools.sharedFormattingDescription: Citation formatting and editor preferences share the Source Editor settings panel.
regex.title: Regex replacer
regex.selectionScope: Replaces only the selection captured when this panel opened.
regex.sectionScope: Replaces text in the current section source.
regex.pageScope: Replaces text in the current page source.
regex.reviewHelp: Review the complete resulting source before applying. Changes stay in the editor until you publish.
regex.applied: Replacements applied to the editor. Review before publishing.
regex.noChanges: The replacement made no source changes.
regex.undoUnavailable: The replacement cannot be undone because the source changed afterward. Use the editor’s undo history if needed.
regex.error.invalid-pattern: This expression or flag combination is not supported. Correct it and preview again.
regex.error.invalid-flags: Use each supported JavaScript flag at most once: d, g, i, m, s, u, v, y.
regex.error.input-too-large: Use at most 2,000,000 source characters, a 10,000-character pattern, and 100,000 replacement characters. Select a smaller range if needed.
regex.error.output-too-large: The resulting source exceeds 2,000,000 characters. Use a smaller selection or replacement.
regex.error.too-many-matches: More than 10,000 matches were found. Narrow the pattern or selection.
regex.error.unavailable: This browser could not start the isolated replacement worker. Allow workers for this wiki and preview again.
regex.error.timeout: The expression took too long and was stopped. Simplify it or select less source, then preview again.
regex.error.source-changed: The source or page changed after this panel opened. Close it and reopen Tools to review the current source.
